visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: One Step Too Many in the Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: There are 8 ways to climb 5 steps, but the program prints 13.

solution.explanation: prev and current already describe steps 1 and 2, so the loop has to start computing at step 3. Starting at 2 runs one extra iteration and returns the answer for n + 1 steps.
